activities.title: Cloud Computing Distinction Graduate – Bangkit 2024 Batch 1
activities.type: Studi Independen MSIB – Kampus Merdeka program
activities.organization: Bangkit led by Google, Goto, and Traveloka
activities.organizationDesc: Bangkit is a unique career readiness program led by Google and delivered with support from industry experts from industry partners like GoTo and Traveloka. The program is designed to provide the participants with first-hand exposure to real-world practitioners and prepare them with relevant skills for a successful career in leading tech companies.
activities.description:
• Selected as one of 4,650 students from 57k+ applicants all over Indonesia.
  • Accepted as one of the two selected teams in the Company Capstone Track (Braincore) from the total of 59 teams.
  • Best Team at Bangkit Company Track Capstone Project with Braincore.
  • Graduated as the top 10% of Best Graduates with Distinction in Cloud Computing Learning Path.
  • Top 50 Best Showcase team Winners of Bangkit Challenge 2: Project Management Challenge.
  • Learned Cloud Computing based on Google Cloud using Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
